Description:

Welcome to this sensational fully furnished garden suite at 2036 W 15th Avenue – a charming and beautifully appointed west-facing home in the heart of Kitsilano, one of Vancouver's most sought-after and vibrant neighbourhoods! This exceptional 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom suite offers 850 sqft of thoughtfully designed living space with a private entrance, unique concrete floors, and a warm, characterful atmosphere that immediately feels like home.

Every detail of this impressive suite has been carefully curated, featuring granite and quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, in-suite laundry, a dedicated office area, and a private entrance that gives this home a wonderfully independent feel – all fully furnished and completely move-in ready from day one. The concrete floors add a stylish industrial touch that sets this suite apart from a typical furnished rental, creating a truly unique and memorable living space in one of Vancouver's most desirable west side communities.

Located just off West 4th Avenue in the heart of Kitsilano, you are surrounded by the neighbourhood's world-class restaurants, coffee shops, yoga studios, and boutique retailers. Kits Beach, the seawall, and excellent transit connections are all just minutes away, making this an outstanding home for professionals or couples seeking a bright and well-connected Kitsilano retreat. Available September 1, 2026 on an annual lease – post now to attract early September interest!
